# test-utils

## test-utils component

### Development

Ensure that all dependencies are install via `npm install`, then:

`npm run build` - execute production build

`npm run clean` - delete all generated code

`npm run lint` - Lints the source code

`npm start` - Start a Webpack development server that builds and serves the module and host page

`npm test` - Run tests.

`npm test -- --coverage` - Generated coverage reports along with tests.

`npm test -- --watch|-W` - Run tests in watch mode.
